feeds.title: DutchCrafters Blog
feeds.description: DutchCrafters has been the largest internet retailer of Amish-made furniture for more than 18 years. We are the destination for solid wood, American-made, Amish furniture that is aligned both with your style and your values. e are able to connect you to personalized, custom-made furniture created by skilled woodworkers. Our Amish furniture and other products are built to be passed down to the next generation.

feeds.title: Timberhaven Blog
feeds.description: Manufactured in the heart of the Appalachian Mountains in Pennsylvania, Timberhaven Log & Timber Homes, LLC. are your choice for quality, affordable kiln-dried log homes, log cabins, timber frame homes, and timber accents. We take great time and energy to make sure that every attention to detail has been met to give you the best value there is in custom wood home living.

feeds.title: Dakota Timber Company Blog
feeds.description: View the Dakota Timber Company blog featuring newsworthy lumber industry content, media features, and more. Dakota Timber Co. manufactures high-quality, American-made wood products with an emphasis on sustainability and low-impact production. Our lumber is sourced regionally from retired buildings and urban tree removals as well as other sustainable sources.

feeds.title: Timber Harvesting
feeds.description: Spanning seven decades since its inception in 1952, Timber Harvesting highlights innovative and successful logging operations across the U.S. and around the world. Timber Harvesting also emphasizes new technology and provides the best marketing vehicle for the industry's suppliers to reach the largest number of loggers in North America and beyond.

feeds.title: Forisk Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 2004, Forisk analyzes forest supplies, wood demand, and timber pricing to develop forecasts and strategic guidance for clients. Our approach emphasizes rigorous research, clear communication, localized analysis, and direct forestry experience.

feeds.title: Elmwood Reclaimed Timber
feeds.description: From artisanal wood accents to freshly milled countertops, to reclaimed wood flooring, we have developed and retained a solid reputation for unmatched honesty, quality, durability, and customer service. We use reclaimed timber for a variety of our antique wood products, but also have new wood products available for homeowners and business owners as well!

feeds.title: Timber Finance
feeds.description: The Timber Finance Initiative, founded in 2021, will become the Swiss competence center for timber investments. We promote the knowledge exchange and networking between the forest and timber industry and the financial market through the development of CO2 methodologies, whitepapers, a Knowledge Hub, training, and advisory services.

feeds.title: Carolina Timberworks Blog
feeds.description: Carolina Timberworks offers the industry's leading timber frame blog filled with information, anecdotes, customer stories, and much, much more. Carolina Timberworks designs build and install timber frames and post and beam structures. We professionally install our timber framing anywhere in the United States.

feeds.title: Timber Industries Blog
feeds.description: In business for more than 80 years, Timber Industries is an experienced, reliable, and a full - service designer, builder, and supplier of pallets, crates, skids, and a wide range of high-quality wood products and expert services.

feeds.title: ResourceWise Blog
feeds.description: Forest2Market's blog covers forestry, wood products, pulp and paper products, bioenergy, biochemicals, and sustainability topics. Forest2Market was founded in January 2000 to empower participants in the global forest, wood products, paper products, biochemical, and bioenergy industries to make exponentially better decisions through the strategic application of industry expertise and unique datasets.

feeds.title: Mid-Atlantic Timberframes Blog
feeds.description: For up-to-date news and project information, please consult our blog. Mid-Atlantic Timberframes is a timber manufacturer located in Lancaster County, PA. We craft heavy and mass timber and design and build timber frames for a variety of projects, including commercial and municipal buildings, custom homes, equestrian facilities, and much more.

feeds.title: Hope Timber Pallet Company Blog
feeds.description: From the very beginning, high-quality service and environmental responsibility were key characteristics of Hope Timber Pallet. Our business is building, repairing, and recycling pallets of any size. From the industry standard 48 x 40 to a custom size for a special item, Hope Timber Pallet can get it done quickly. Read our blog to know more about pallets, storage and supply industry, news, insights and more!
